literal: Evening-affliction causing, my lover not-departing morning, I did not know.
translation: In the morning, when my beloved had not departed from me, I did not know that the evening would bring such painful affliction.
modern: என் கணவர் என்னை விட்டுப் பிரியாத காலைப் பொழுதில், மாலைப் பொழுது இத்தகைய துன்பத்தைத் தரும் என்பதை நான் அறிந்திருக்கவில்லை.
explanation: The heroine, suffering from the pain of separation, laments the arrival of the evening. She reflects on the morning when her lover was still by her side, a time of joy and security. At that time, she could not have anticipated how agonizing the evening would become once he departed. The contrast between 'காலை' (morning) and 'மாலை' (evening) highlights how quickly her state of mind shifted from happiness to deep sorrow.
